universalMark.meaning: Create, edit, version, convert, inspect ancestry, or connect the selected item to another Infinity value type.
universalMark.presentation: A subtle 15 by 15 pixel mark in the upper-right corner of every convertible object, using the same position and behavior across the platform.
universalMark.notMeaning: The mark is not a favorite, rating, endorsement, verified badge, or promise of value.

modules.name: Alien Radio
modules.productToken: AI-assisted radio-station identity, channels, research, creator tools, Store Card offers, and station activation.
modules.systemNeed: Radio stations need a complete attributable product, a versioned design, verified use, and one locked Avatar Coin per active station identity.

modules.name: Hotel Night
modules.productToken: One verified night at a named hotel, room class, date window, accessibility configuration, tax treatment, cancellation rule, and fulfillment method.
modules.systemNeed: Coin Planner and Good Bee need exact hotel capacity before a vacation package can publish.

modules.name: Accessible Home Component
modules.productToken: A robot-readable, inspectable and replaceable housing component with dimensions, materials, connections, installation steps, tests, rights, warranty, and local-code status.
modules.systemNeed: Infinity Robotic Housing needs standardized verified components before homes can be assembled or repaired safely.

modules.name: Good Bee Destination Package
modules.productToken: A funded combination of hotel nights, transportation, meals, products, accessibility, support, activities, return travel, and person approvals.
modules.systemNeed: People need complete understandable packages rather than disconnected claims and surprise costs.

modules.name: Business Plan Coin
modules.productToken: A living business record containing the problem, product, capacity, storefront, rights, costs, milestones, contributions, advertising budget, and child branches.
modules.systemNeed: People need AI-assisted businesses that can become verified products and services rather than remaining undocumented ideas.

modules.name: AI-Matched Work Role
modules.productToken: A defined work role with deliverable, quality test, required tools, accessibility, time expectation, rights, reviewer, and compensation rule.
modules.systemNeed: New Hope needs real paid roles generated from interests and abilities rather than labeling people unproductive.

modules.name: Store Card Offer
modules.productToken: A signed product or service offer with provider, quantity, price, funding, inventory, restrictions, expiration, delivery, return, dispute, and NFC fulfillment rules.
modules.systemNeed: Store Cards need exact claims that can be used, bundled, fulfilled, converted, retired, corrected, and audited.
